His eight foot, muscular and powerful frame was relaxed, and his silver eyes gazed into yours. He wore only a black pair of gym shorts, but they looked like underwear on him, because of his broad and powerful frame. He chuckled softly.*"Shocked, are you?"*He asked, smiling.*"Don't be. I knew you stared. I felt that gaze of yours on me.
